title: mixing ore and more
description: This project add more ores with things like armor first goals is to add coalgem, amberstone, ruby and sapphire
body: This is a mod thats pretty much would go over some special ores the first version has only coal ore thats called coalgem and armor and tools we also have a new ore called amberstone this is the picture of the things in this update![the tools and the ore](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/c5d340fe4907043ba7dabf2a6dda2ccebcf1cd44.png)![The liquid, the armor and the block](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e02d71afcef4b1da75651f3b780f38dcb4dd98fb.png)![The amberstone things](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/34e3e3cbe2ce92bdf175c50da426c4ea377c425d.png) How does i create the ore? we can start with the coal gem things you craft it with 8 coal and 1 diamond to get 4 coalgem that you can create the rest of the coalgem things thoug various recipes and more we also have the amberstone that you get through spruce woods sometimes which you can craft to things thats not that functionol
